tags.documentation:
This tag represents the configuration of the feeder. It has to be duplicated as many times as feeders are in the project. The name of the tag has to match with one of the values in the "feeder" column of the "solarFeeders" dataset. The information in this tag has to be completed with project specific information for each feeder.
    -SKD: Differentiating part of the name for the skids. It has to match with the skid folder in Ignition and the channel in the OPC server.
    -trk1: True if the skid has a TCU, false if it doesn't have one.
    -trk2: Some tracker systems have more that one TCU per skid. True if the skid has a second TCU, false if it doesn't have one.
    -trk3: Some tracker systems have more that one TCU per skid. True if the skid has a third TCU, false if it doesn't have one.
    -ref: True if the skid has a REF station, false if it doesn't have one.
    -met: True if the skid has a MET/SOIL station, false if it doesn't have one.
    -metNum: MET/SOIL station number if the skid has a MET/SOIL station. The value will be ignored if "met" is false.
tags.name: F2A-1
tags.tooltip: Feeder configuration tag (Duplicate and rename if more feeders are needed).

tags.documentation:

tags.documentation:
This tag represents the configuration of the site. The information in this tag has to be completed with project specific information.
    -feeder: Name of the solar feeders in the project. This name has to match with the name of the configuration tags created for each feeder.
    -meter: Name of the meter coming from the substation RTU representing the production values coming out of the specific feeder. It could be a dedicated meter or the values coming from the feeder breaker's relay.
    -modules: Total number of modules for all the inverters in the feeder. If this value is set to 0 the "Inverter Modules" value won't be displayed in the "Feeder Tile".
